{
  "implementation": "def solve(case):
    round_scores = case['round_scores']
    round_targets = case['round_targets']
    forced = case['forced']
    n_indices = len(round_scores[0])
    active = list(range(n_indices))
    history = []
    for r in range(len(round_scores)):
        forced_set = {i for i in forced if i in active}
        others = [i for i in active if i not in forced_set]
        others_sorted = sorted(others, key=lambda i: round_scores[r][i], reverse=True)
        budget = round_targets[r]
        num_forced = len(forced_set)
        num_pick = budget - num_forced
        selected = list(forced_set) + others_sorted[:num_pick]
        selected.sort()
        history.append(selected)
        active = selected
    return {'history': history, 'retained_indices': active}"
}
